items.title: Rebranded NodThera plans IPO to fund NLRP3 inhibitor’s push toward approval
items.summary: NodThera—under its new name Rezera—is planning an IPO as the biotech steps up its ambitions to get its NLRP3 inhibitor to market.

items.title: ESMO: AZ, Hutchmed’s Orpathys combo shows post-Tagrisso power in MET-driven lung cancer
items.summary: AstraZeneca has offered a detailed look at the phase 3 non-small cell lung cancer data that finally position its Hutchmed-partnered Orpathys for an FDA approval more than five years after the MET inhibitor’s initial go-ahead in China.

items.title: GSK's double FDA win, Roche's $15B deal and the rise of point-of-care marketing
items.summary: This week on "The Top Line," we cover GSK's pair of FDA approvals, Roche's $15 billion ADC deal and the rise of point-of-care pharma marketing.

items.title: FDA rebukes Baxter over 'repeated' production stumbles in new warning letter
items.summary: The FDA rebuked Baxter in a lengthy warning letter that outlined a series of production violations that led to a trio of recalls earlier this year.

items.title: Roivant comes for Humira as Lisraya checks boxes in inflammatory eye disease phase 3s
items.summary: With the ink barely dry on Lisraya’s first approval, Roivant and its spinout Priovant are wasting little time in making the case for the dual TYK2/JAK1 inhibitor to claim a larger immune-mediated kingdom.

items.title: AMA and EMA issue joint guidance on Ebola vaccine development
items.summary: EMA’s Emergency Task Force (ETF) and the African Medicines Agency (AMA) have published a joint position paper to support the timely start of clinical trials for potential…

items.title: Clinical trial applications advice pilot becomes permanent
items.summary: The Accelerating Clinical Trials in the EU (ACT EU) advice pilot, which helps sponsors prepare clinical trial applications, will become a permanent initiative from January 2027…

items.title: ESMO: BMS’ Massacesi hails ‘very promising’ data for BioNTech-partnered PD-L1xVEGF-A drug
items.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb Chief Medical Officer Cristian Massacesi, M.D., has told Fierce that the latest data for its BioNTech-partnered PD-L1xVEGF-A drug are “very promising,” as phase 3 ambitions ramp up.v

items.title: ESMO: Roche touts ‘convincing’ phase 3 KRAS data after win over rivals
items.summary: Roche has shed more light on its investigational KRAS G12C inhibitor’s phase 3 victory over Amgen’s Lumakras and Bristol Myers Squibb’s Krazati.

items.title: ESMO: AstraZeneca exec insists phase 3 ADC data ‘robust’ enough for regulators despite PFS miss
items.summary: An AstraZeneca executive was adamant that detailed data from a phase 3 study of the pharma’s next-generation antibody-drug conjugate are “robust” enough to take to regulators, despite the trial failing to meet a key endpoint.

items.title: ESMO: GSK cancer R&D chief says mo-rez data ‘reinforces our belief’ in ADC as phase 3 push ramps up
items.summary: GSK’s cancer R&D chief has suggested the latest slice of early-stage data on its B7-H4-directed antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) has “reinforce[d] our belief in the asset,” as the therapy races through a clutch of phase 3 studies.

items.title: Roche puts numbers behind phase 3 kidney disease win amid blockbuster ambitions
items.summary: Roche's Genentech has put numbers behind its phase 3 success in IgA nephropathy (IgAN), reporting that antisense oligonucleotide sefaxersen reduced a key marker of kidney damage by 43.1% compared with placebo.

items.title: ESMO: Boehringer builds case for late-phase rival to Amgen’s Imdelltra
items.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim has shared data on its DLL3xCD3 T-cell engager, providing pointers to the prospects of a would-be rival to Amgen’s Imdelltra that entered phase 3 this year.

items.title: ESMO: Takeda’s $1.2B bet on Innovent ‘absolutely’ pays off with details of ADC’s phase 3 win
items.summary: Takeda has lifted the lid on the phase 3 win for its next-generation claudin18.2 drug, with the antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) demonstrating overall survival of 10.2 months.

items.title: ESMO: After leak, Merck and Moderna post phase 3 cancer vaccine data early
items.summary: Merck & Co. and Moderna have shared highly anticipated phase 3 data on their cancer vaccine ahead of schedule, revealing a primary endpoint hit that approached analysts’ best-case scenario. But the positive result was offset by weaker-than-expected data on a key secondary endpoint.

items.title: AbbVie scratches out phase 3 hidradenitis suppurativa win but falls short of expectations
items.summary: A phase 3 trial of AbbVie’s lutikizumab in hidradenitis suppurativa has hit its primary endpoint. But with the drug candidate beating placebo by a narrower margin than expected, the readout raises questions about AbbVie’s chances of cracking a competitive market.

items.title: ‘Infinite potential’: Akeso CEO looks for more ivonescimab combos amid AstraZeneca investment, new phase 3 win
items.summary: With ivonescimab’s first phase 3 win outside lung cancer and a $2 billion investment from AstraZeneca in its U.S. partner Summit Therapeutics, Akeso CEO Michelle Xia, Ph.D., is expecting more combination opportunities for its star PD-1xVEGF bispecific.

items.title: ESMO: Merck, Kelun’s ‘workhorse’ ADC posts major tumor progression benefit in PD-L1-negative NSCLC
items.summary: Sac-TMT showed a strong tumor progression benefit in first-line, PD-L1-negative non-small cell lung cancer in a China phase 3 trial that could help Merck close a high-stakes gap in its expansive global development program for the Kelun-Biotech-partnered ADC.

items.title: Bayer's Nubeqa scores phase 3 win in high-risk prostate cancer
items.summary: Nubeqa, when added to standard-of-care treatment, significantly improved metastasis-free survival in patients with very high-risk localized prostate cancer.

items.title: Argenx confirmatory trial update for Vyvgart puts small dent in strong Q3
items.summary: Argenx's third quarter report reflected strong sales and pipeline plans, but investors took issue with high operating expenses and a new phase 3 requirement.

items.title: AZ's Ultomiris adds 5th rare disease feather to cap with FDA IgAN nod
items.summary: With a late Thursday nod from the FDA to reduce protein levels in the urine of patients with primary immunoglobulin A nephropathy (IgAN), AstraZeneca’s Alexion-born Ultomiris has racked up its fifth rare disease indication in the United States.

items.title: New US drug launches need price check to counter access impediments, ICER, West Health urge
items.summary: As policies from the last two presidential administrations put heightened focus on drug affordability in the United States, a new report suggests much work remains to be done when it comes to the launch prices of novel medicines.

items.title: Gilead to pay $1.3B upfront for PepStar’s oral IL-23 challenger to J&J’s Icotyde
items.summary: Gilead has struck a deal to acquire PepStar Therapeutics’ oral IL-23 receptor inhibitor program for $1.275 billion, positioning itself as a would-be challenger to Johnson & Johnson’s Icotyde across a range of inflammatory diseases.

items.title: ESMO: J&J exec says RIPTAC readout is ‘best data we’ve ever seen’ for a prostate cancer drug
items.summary: A year after paying over $3 billion for Halda Therapeutics, Johnson & Johson has unveiled the first data from its shiny new RIPTAC pipeline that it believes could sustain its leading role in prostate cancer.

items.title: ‘It is what it is’: Merck exec unruffled by ‘unfortunate’ leak of ESMO cancer vaccine data
items.summary: Merck & Co. and Moderna always knew they would be making headlines in Madrid this week—just not in the way it happened.

items.title: ESMO: Lilly touts 79% ADC response rate in competitive ovarian cancer space
items.summary: Eli Lilly has shared phase 1 data on an antibody-drug conjugate in platinum-sensitive ovarian cancer, shedding light on the company’s chances of competing for a market targeted by rivals including AbbVie and Genmab.

items.title: ESMO: Zentalis already dreaming of launch for WEE1 inhibitor after ‘great result’ in early-stage test
items.summary: Zentalis Pharmaceuticals has pointed to the first overall survival (OS) analysis for azenosertib as proof that the oral WEE1 tyrosine kinase inhibitor can offer a convenient oral treatment for a tricky cancer.

items.title: EQT buys molecular diagnostics specialist Qiagen in a €10.8B deal
items.summary: EQT is buying up Netherlands-based Qiagen in a deal worth €10.8 billion ($12.1 billion) in enterprise value that includes $1.1 billion in net debt.

items.title: Bolt makes inflammation play with Prana reverse merger, $120M financing
items.summary: Bolt Biotherapeutics is acquiring Prana Therapies in a stock-for-stock reverse merger backed by a $120 million financing to advance Prana’s lead antibody through multiple phase 2 trials in inflammatory diseases.

items.title: Chutes & Ladders—Troubled CSL enlists GSK vet Deborah Waterhouse to lead
items.summary: CSL has tapped a new leader to steer it through a make-or-break period. Ironwood's CEO since 2021 is hanging up his hat. CytoDyn's new helmsman is highlighting the company's "transformational period." And more.

items.title: BMS leads Pathos AI's $237M series E alongside Alzheimer's link-up
items.summary: Pathos AI has closed a $237 million series E round led by pharma giant Bristol Myers Squibb on the same day that the two companies signed a cutting-edge Alzheimer's disease-focused collaboration.
